items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: finally, John Hammonds came back and got me and uh, Pete Johnson and took us to New York, and we uh...went to New York, and he recorded us.

ctx.x: He took Count Basie's band first, and he wanted me to go with Count Basie's band and leave Jimmy Rushing but I wouldn't go because Jimmy Rushing had been working with Count Basie's band all along, and I was with Pete Johnson's band, so I tol' him I didn't want to go with Count Basie. I'll wait till he come back and he pick up my band.

So's Count Basie and them went to New York City. They stayed up there a long time, and, uh, finally, John Hammonds came back and got me and uh, Pete Johnson and took us to New York, and we uh...went to New York, and he recorded us. Then we met Meade Lux Lewis and Albert Ammons in Chica...in New York City.
